name: microlaunch
description: A way for Microlaunch users and community to browse indie software, new launches and maker deals with their AI assistant.

interface.longDescription:
Microlaunch is a software discovery directory where indie makers and startups launch their products and the community votes on them. This app is a way for Microlaunch users and the community to browse it with their AI assistant: more than 5,000 tools and apps, right in ChatGPT.

• See the top tools in a category, such as AI, marketing, productivity or developer tools.
• Find out what launched today, this week or this month.
• Look up a product: what it does, stage, votes, reviews and awards, with links to its website.
• Browse active maker deals and discounts (codes are claimed on Microlaunch).

Safety and quality: listings are screened for a general audience and products that aren't suitable for all ages are left out. Rankings come from community votes, and links to broken websites are withheld.
defaultPrompt: What are the best AI tools on Microlaunch?
What launched on Microlaunch this week?

positive.prompt: What are the best AI tools on Microlaunch?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the 10 top products in the AI category by community votes in the widget and a link to the full category on Microlaunch.

positive.prompt: What launched on Microlaunch this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows this week's top-ranked launches as a leaderboard with votes; if the week has fewer than three launches it widens to the last 30 days and says so.

positive.prompt: Show me the top marketing launches on Microlaunch this month
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the top launches from the last 30 days in the marketing category, each linking to the product's website.

positive.prompt: Tell me about Tag Parrot on Microlaunch
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Tag Parrot's card (what it does, category, stage, votes, reviews, awards) with buttons to visit its website and its Microlaunch page.
Lists active marketing deals (title, type, value) with links to claim them on Microlaunch; coupon codes are not shown in chat.

negative.description: Write actions are not supported (submitting a launch)
negative.prompt: Submit my startup to Microlaunch for me
Book me a flight to Lisbon next Friday

review.commerce_description: This app does not sell products or process payments. It only shows public product listings and links to microlaunch.net.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: best-in-category, recent launches, product details and maker deals.
